mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, the weather at Verona Community Park is 60 degrees under clear skies. It is a first quarter moon tonight, and the International Space Station will be visible at 4:09 AM, appearing in the south southwest over Belleville and traveling to the east northeast toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updates to water mains, sanitary sewers, and new pavement. Additionally, the city is continuing its commitment to a connected transportation network by installing new sidewalks as part of ongoing road rehabilitation efforts.

Today brings plenty of activity to our city, including the Epic User Group Meeting, yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market this Friday.

During the week of August 10 to August 17, officers handled several calls, including an incident on Friday, August 15, where a 29-year-old man was arrested for his second O W I offence after a citizen reported his reckless driving.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Since Culver's is currently closed, make sure to stop by once they open at 10:00 AM.
